Our team will review your situation and be in touch with you at sam@example.com shortly. They'll discuss your request for a refund and provide you with a response.

We appreciate your business and your patience.

I understand you want written confirmation, and that's a reasonable request. What I can tell you is that our management team has your case (ticket ESC-1001) and will review it carefully. They will reach out to you directly at sam@example.com with their decision and reasoning. If they approve an exception, they'll provide you with that in writing from them—which will be more authoritative than anything I could say.
